crossRefs.note: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his…
Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called…
Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;
Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;
The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.
He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

people.name: Thomas
people.line: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting

translations.web: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s go also, that we may die with him.”
translations.bsb: Then Thomas called Didymus said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.”
translations.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
translations.asv: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said unto his fellow-disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
